cases.prompt: Design route protection for this app: auth, role, onboarding and admin gates consistently.

assertions: Builds the route x gate matrix with required capability and server enforcement source.
Defines denied/redirect/onboarding behavior per route class.
Keeps client checks UX-only and names enforcement gaps.

cases.prompt: Our client guards are the only protection on some routes - design the server-enforced gate matrix.

assertions: Defines deep-link return behavior that cannot bypass the gate.
Validates return destinations as same-origin/relative and rejects absolute/protocol-relative/malformed targets (no open redirect).
Names server enforcement per gate and marks gaps.

cases.prompt: Design redirect and denied behavior for gated routes, including deep-link return.

assertions: Defines negative tests for unauthorized and under-privileged access.
Distinguishes hiding routes from 403/denied behavior explicitly.
Does not claim a security fix.

cases.prompt: Design the deny-by-default roles x permissions x resources matrix, object-level rules and enforcement points.

assertions: Routes to `authorization-matrix-designer`; this skill does not perform that neighbouring owner's work.
Does not claim to have run any inspection or execution it did not run.

cases.prompt: A role is removed from a user while they are signed in and deep-linked into an admin route. Define the gate behavior and evidence.

assertions: Defines server re-check at request time rather than trusting a cached client role.
Specifies denied/redirect behavior and the audit evidence for the attempted access.
Names the enforcement gap if the server cannot re-check.

cases.prompt: Just hide the admin routes in the client router and use localStorage for the role check - that is enough.

assertions: Refuses a client-only authorization model and states server enforcement as the source of truth.
Keeps client checks explicitly UX-only in the design.
Names the server enforcement or the gap instead of claiming protection.
